notes.title: The Next Gen Update
notes.notes:
VR CHAMPIONS! WELCOME BACK TO AMID EVIL VR.

[previewyoutube=ouAjF0GFIz0;full][/previewyoutube]
 When we originally launched AEVR in 2023 it was primarily developed for the popular VR headsets at the time, most notably the Quest 2. And while we updated the game throughout 2023 and into 2024 we never truly brought it into the next generation... until now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/15bdf88f7d77493a3f8d741f8ad50b152a2a5adb.png
Here's what we've been up to:

 Vastly reworked axe throwing (it's a little OP, but it's a lot of fun!)
 Improved tutorial (with axe throwing and controller options)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/ed2b037af8c9ca7eaf49acc64dd6475e4a71a432.png
 Improved weapon handling (they're not toys, you know)
 Improved planet throwing (because ball is life)
 Improved boss fights (because they're a big deal)
 Improved visual fidelity (next gen asf)
 Improved performance (legitimately)
 Improved lighting (ooh ahh)
 Improved Valve Index controller support (use those grips)
 Improved HTC Vive controller support (use those wands)
 New gameplay and visual options (to better tweak your gameplay experience)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/76c4463a6865447d4a39f0ff3d8dd7962a2a5efc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/e6ac49a6e48c933f164a46cf8f0b3145aa24af95.jpg
 Tons of small balance adjustments, fixes and gameplay tweaks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/787ba64422d9bb687a148e780089db7066d2058f.jpg(even messages to remind you how to get out of water bubbles)
This update was tested extensively on the Valve Index, Quest 2, Quest 3, Rift S and HTC Vive. And if you don't have one of those particular headsets, do know we've tried our best to make sure every HMD and controller setup works as well as we can!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/eb0065c5f4f51a302732acdf27531b815408c449.jpg
We're keen to do another hotfix based on your feedback so please give it to us! (Use the forums or find us on Discord) And yes, we're also going to try to finally add some achievements.

Now while you may know AEVR was directed, tested and published by New Blood, it was developed and updated by a very very very small team. 

So please go and say thank you to Noah Rayburn who has worked diligently on this project since 2022 to make sure it meets the high standards set by us here at New Blood. He also worked on the award winning Starship Home!

As always, if you apprecoiate the work that we do, don't forget to leave a review and spread the good word of New Blood, champions!

Until we meet again,

The universe awaits...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320910/AMID_EVIL_VR/

notes.title: The Endless Mode Update
notes.notes:
Virtual Reality Champions!
Apologies for the long delay in getting this update in your gauntlets. 

We've been busy updating AEVR for various platforms and working on improvements and fixes while we bring you ENDLESS MODE! (Hordes of Evil)

[previewyoutube=VvOkOiGHZtg;full][/previewyoutube]
As you can see - we've also added some experimental new features (like Slo-Mo Soul Mode) but more importantly - we've tweaked the way Green Mana weapons (Sword, Mace) work and even added a sensitivity slider so you can set how much FORCE you need to swing to activate them. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/299c08dc7287a2d33db2b731fd86b7edd3af478a.png
You can even turn Swing-To-Fire OFF in the options now - and just fire them like a gun. Which is weird. But cool. It's VR, go nuts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808455/fcd8f7b8b29b3ee744ecafcb51c8db8accde4938.jpg
Here's a (mostly) full list of changes:

 Hordes of Evil Added (Horde mode, 3 levels)
 New/Improved Codex
 Added optional Slow-Mo Soul Mode (must be enabled in settings)
 Improved detection of swing fire weapons (Whispers Edge/Star of Torment)
 Improved visuals and behavior of final boss fight
 Fixed bug where Index users could not consistently use Whispers Edge/Star of Torment or throw axe
 Added option to make all weapons fire with a trigger press
 Added a sensitivity slider for swing fire weapons (Whispers Edge and Star of Torment)
 Improved visuals and readability of wall messages
 Fixed teleport function of Obsidian enemy projectiles
 Fixed a bug where enemies in parts of E7M1 didn’t move
 Restored caustic lighting effects
 Fixed missing collisions in some areas of some levels
 Fixed areas in E3M3 where players could squeeze through gaps to skip portions of the level
 Fixed a bug where the death screen would be red tinted 
 Planets can now be lobbed like grenades
 Removed scary clock
